title: Mid-Anterior Tibial Stress Fracture in a Female Elite Athlete : A Case Report.
journal: European journal of trauma and emergency surgery : official publication of the European Trauma Society

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: We report the case of an unusual tibial stress fracture and its successful surgical treatment in a female elite sprinter 2 years after complete consolidation of the same tibia following resection of an osteoid osteoma.
